issues.detail: The Hebrew says 30,500 donkeys (שְׁלֹשִׁים אֶלֶף וַחֲמֵשׁ מֵאוֹת = 30,000 + 500), but the Chinese says 三萬一千匹 (31,000). The number is wrong.
The Hebrew says the tribute to the LORD was 61 (אֶחָד וְשִׁשִּׁים = one and sixty = 61), but the Chinese says 每六十匹納一匹 (one out of every sixty), which changes the ratio from 1/500 (30,500/61) to 1/60.
